description: Implementation of ChargeReadPlatformService for retrieving and managing charge data in the Fineract platform, including methods for fetching charges, product-specific charges, and charge details with office-specific filtering.

classes.name: ChargeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of charge retrieval and management service with office-specific filtering in Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveAllCharges
methods.description: Fetches all non-deleted charges with office-specific filtering, ordered by name.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesForCurrency
methods.description: Fetches all non-deleted charges for a specific currency with office-specific filtering, ordered by name.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Retrieves a specific charge by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Provides default data and options for creating a new charge, including currencies, calculation types, accounts, and tax groups.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Fetches charges associated with a specific loan product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Fetches charges for a loan product filtered by charge time.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableFees
methods.description: Fetches applicable loan fees excluding penalties.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Fetches applicable charges for a specific loan account, with optional charge time exclusions.

methods.name: processChargeExclusionsForLoans
methods.description: Helper to exclude certain charge times from loan charges.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Fetches charges for a loan product, with optional charge time exclusions.

methods.name: addInClauseToSQL_toLimitChargesMappedToOffice_ifOfficeSpecificProductsEnabled
methods.description: Appends office-specific charge filtering clause if branch-specific products are enabled.

methods.name: ChargeMapper
methods.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to ChargeData objects, with schema methods for different product types.
